chronicle: Bo settled down and founded the village.
Ada worked out how to keep a fire.
The village began building a fire pit.
The fire pit was finished and the fire lit.
Ada found stone a short walk to the north-east.
Bo worked out how to lay a road.
Rowan worked out how to knap stone into tools.
Perch worked out how to store food and goods for everyone.
The village began building a storehouse.
The storehouse was finished.
Perch worked out how to put a wall round the village.
The village reached 10 people.
Perch worked out how to build with stone.
Tam found stone out to the south-east.
Perch worked out how to plant and tend crops.
Perch laid out the village's first wheat field.
The village reached 25 people.
The village began putting a wooden wall round its houses.
Perch worked out how to carry water to the fields.
Linnet found stone out to the south.
The village began a wall round its fields.
Orin worked out how to raise a monument.
The village began raising a monument.
The village reached 50 people.
The first tier of the monument was laid.
The wooden wall round the houses was finished.
The monument's last tier was laid.
A fire was lit on top of the finished monument.
The village began building a keep in the middle of the village.
Cass found stone out to the south-west.
A wall round the fields was finished.
The keep was finished. The fire and the store moved inside it.
The village began building a temple on a hill to the north-east.
Jory found stone in the hills to the north-east.
The village opened its first quarry, in the hills to the north-east.
The village reached 100 people.
Gwen found stone out to the south.
The houses outside the wall were many enough for another wall round them all.
Gwen found stone out to the east.
Another wall round the town was finished.
The village began rebuilding a wall in stone.
